capabilities: Style canvas text with colors and font scale
Branch mind map cards with right-angle connectors
Import Mermaid flowcharts and mind maps
Copy and paste canvas nodes as JSON
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and uses internal Canvas APIs, so editing and clipboard behavior should be rechecked after Obsidian upgrades; plugin-specific styling and precise node jumps stop working when the plugin is disabled. README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
intentEvidence: Turn Obsidian Canvas into a real whiteboard with minimal changes
motivation: The author wanted to turn Canvas into a real whiteboard while changing the existing Canvas data format as little as possible, so a user and an AI agent can edit the same board.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Canvas offers little text styling and no branching tools, so building mind maps and flowcharts on a board takes manual work.
summary: Adds borderless text, text colors, font scaling, right-angle mind-map connectors and Mermaid import to Obsidian Canvas.
